# Let me try pressing UP multiple times to see if the player can move up
# Current player position: row=36.0, col=27.5

print("Testing UP 10 times:")
for i in range(10):
    action(['UP'])
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        if n['color'] == 'O':
            b = n['boundary']
            rows = [p[0] for p in b]
            cols = [p[1] for p in b]
            pr = (min(rows)+max(rows))/2
            pc = (min(cols)+max(cols))/2
            print(f"  After UP {i+1}: row={pr}, col={pc}")
            break
    
    yellow_birds = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'Y' and n['pixels'] == 3]
    if len(yellow_birds) < 6:
        print(f"  Bird count decreased to {len(yellow_birds)}!")
        break
    
    if last_action_result.get('level_completed'):
        print("  Level completed!")
        break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
